stem: Each year a transport firm uses $X$ litres of gasoline and $Y$ litres of diesel fuel, where $X$ and $Y$ have the independent distributions $X \sim \text{N}(10\,700, 950^2)$ and $Y \sim \text{N}(13\,400, 1210^2)$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that in a randomly chosen year the firm uses more gasoline than diesel fuel.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: The costs per litre of gasoline and diesel fuel are \$0.80 and \$0.85 respectively.
parts.text: Find the probability that the total cost of gasoline and diesel fuel in a randomly chosen year is between \$20\,000 and \$22\,000.
